privacyPolicyBody.message:
Privacy Policy

Effective: July 16, 2026  |  Last updated: July 16, 2026

Parro Recorder (the “Extension”) values your privacy and processes personal information as described below and in accordance with applicable law.

1. Information We Collect

The Extension collects the following information only while recording is active.

  • Screenshots of webpages on which you click
  • The page URL and title where the click occurred
  • User activity such as clicked-element information, selectors, coordinates, timestamps, and page navigation
  • General input content and input screens to the extent needed to create manual steps and run Live Guide. Values from password fields and fields identified as passwords are not stored.
  • Microphone audio (optional) only when you explicitly enable Voice Narration on the Pro plan. The microphone is not accessed when this feature is off.
  • Account-linking information, including a session token and account identifier used to connect the Extension to your Parro account
  • Desktop capture information (optional) when you explicitly start capture from the desktop app

Screenshots may contain personal information visible on the webpage. Avoid recording pages with sensitive information, or use the available blur feature.

2. How We Use Information

  • Analyze screenshots with AI (Claude) to generate action titles and descriptions
  • Transcribe recorded audio with AI (OpenAI Whisper) for step descriptions and, when requested, convert text to AI speech (TTS)
  • Provide the generated step-by-step guides

3. Storage and Transmission

  • Screenshots and audio files are uploaded to and stored in Supabase cloud storage.
  • AI analysis is processed through the Anthropic Claude API; speech transcription and synthesis are processed through the OpenAI API. API keys are managed only on the server and are not stored on your device.
  • Temporary recording data is stored in browser local storage (chrome.storage.local) during a session and deleted after transfer or cancellation. Account-linking tokens and settings may remain on the device until you disconnect your account or delete the Extension’s data.

4. Third-Party Services

Collected information is used only as needed to provide the service through:

  • Supabase (supabase.com) — image and audio storage and database services
  • Anthropic (anthropic.com) — AI image analysis and text generation
  • OpenAI (openai.com) — speech transcription (Whisper) and synthesis (TTS)

We do not sell or provide collected information to third parties for marketing, advertising, or unrelated purposes.

We use collected information only to provide or improve user-facing Parro Recorder features. We do not use it for personalized or retargeted advertising, credit evaluation, or data sales, and we do not allow people to read user data except with explicit consent or when permitted for security investigations or legal obligations.

5. Retention and Deletion

The local cache is deleted immediately after recording is complete. You may request deletion of images and metadata stored on the server. Contact: kinjungho@gmail.com

6. Your Rights

  • You start and stop recording yourself. The Extension collects no recording data while inactive.
  • You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of collected data.

7. Contact

For privacy questions, contact:
Email: kinjungho@gmail.com
